question: Does truth score high on the alignment + geo necessary-condition filters across the cohort, and does the body-twin match?
hypothesis: Truth scores >=0.95 on both filters on the recoverable cohort and the body-twin matches truth.
narrative_md: Cohort run (100 seeds x 1000 random candidates) reframes alignment/geo cost as one-sided necessary-condition rejection filters. Truth scores 1.0 align on 80/100, 1.0 geo on 73/76 defined; body-twin matches truth on every defined seed; truth percentile rank median 0.001. On the median seed the filter intersection rejects every random candidate. Decisive positive on the necessary-condition reframe.
